# Overview pictograms

Twelve unmodified SVG source files from [Lucide](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide),
pinned to revision `be09619c1c1124ad09c19fc3e87ee3b939409bbd`.

Source: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/be09619c1c1124ad09c19fc3e87ee3b939409bbd/icons/NAME.svg`.
The upstream `LICENSE` is preserved verbatim, including the Feather MIT notice.
See it before redistributing these assets. The site build embeds selected
paths and the full notices in each global overview SVG; no icon package or
third-party request is needed in the browser.
